# Project Instructions

- This is a static website. Pages live in the repository root; shared styles are in `css/style.css`, shared browser behavior is in `js/script.js`, and visual assets are in `images/`.
- Keep changes aligned with the existing plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript approach. There is no package-based build or test workflow.
- Navigation, footer content, and shared interactions appear across multiple pages. When changing them, check the affected pages for consistency and preserve any page-specific behavior.
- Use relative asset paths with forward slashes in HTML, such as `images/logo2.jpg`.
- Validate visual changes in a browser at desktop and mobile widths. The workspace is configured for Live Server on port `5501`.
